title: ExampleCLI 4.2.0 hooks report source "fork": SessionStart matcher is startup|resume
body:
Found in the ExampleCLI 4.2.0 review. Not yet verified against this repo.

## ExampleCLI change(s)

> Session-start hooks now report source `"fork"` for forked sessions instead of `"resume"`.
>
> — [v4.2.0](https://github.com/example-vendor/example-cli/releases/tag/v4.2.0), published 2026-07-14T09:47Z

## Why it may matter here

- `.example-cli/settings.json` matches SessionStart on `startup|resume`, so `hooks/session-start.sh` may stop running for forked sessions.
